_note: AI-capability topics tracked in the OpenAlex research feed. Each count is the number of works matching the query in a half-year; momentum = year-over-year change in the topic's share of all AI works (the 'baseline' query), which cancels most indexing lag.

topics.label: AI agents & agentic workflows
topics.query: "AI agent" OR "agentic AI" OR "LLM agent" OR "LLM agents" OR "agentic workflow"

topics.label: Document AI & OCR
topics.query: "document understanding" OR "optical character recognition" OR "document information extraction"

topics.label: AI safety, governance & fairness
topics.query: "AI governance" OR "responsible AI" OR "AI safety" OR "algorithmic fairness"

topics.label: AI for energy & grids
topics.query: ("machine learning" OR "artificial intelligence") AND ("renewable energy" OR "smart grid" OR "energy management")

topics.label: AI for health
topics.query: ("machine learning" OR "artificial intelligence") AND ("clinical" OR "medical imaging" OR "healthcare")

topics.label: AI for agriculture
topics.query: ("machine learning" OR "artificial intelligence") AND ("precision agriculture" OR "smart farming" OR "crop yield")

scenarios.label: Slow AI disruption
scenarios.description: Adoption is held back by cost, regulation and trust; AI effects arrive at half the current pace.

scenarios.label: Moderate (current trend)
scenarios.description: AI capabilities keep advancing at the pace observed in the latest research and job-post signals.

scenarios.label: Fast AI disruption
scenarios.description: Agentic AI scales quickly across offices and industry; AI effects arrive at twice the current pace.

model._note: Transparent model constants (team assumptions, editable). Annual log-growth units. Raw job-post momentum is clipped to +/- market_momentum_clip, then shrunk with an empirical-Bayes factor prior_sd^2 / (prior_sd^2 + SE^2).
